Maya R: Need a concise one-sheet for enterprise leads tied to the webinar. Focus: security, SLA callouts, and deploy-mode guidance. Aim: single page AEs can use in first convo.
Becca (Content): Draft hero + bullets pasted below for quick take:
Becca (Content): “Hero: Production LLM inference 	6 secure, SLA-backed, and deployable where you need it.
Bullets:
• Security first: KMS/HSM, SOC2-grade audit logs, RBAC
• SLA & reliability: p99 availability target; Dedicated throughput SLAs; automated hosted fallback
• Deployment choices: Hosted API, Reserved Dedicated, Private VPC / on-prem
• Cost levers: batching, quantization, and prefix caching”
Noah (Bench): Tiny benchmark blurb suggestion: “Bench highlight: Dedicated pool peaks ~8k tokens/sec; median token latency ~8ms; p95 ~120ms at 1k qps. Full results: https://bench.redwood/enterprise”
Arun (PM): Add a 1-line latency vs cost callout: “Latency vs cost: choose Dedicated for low p99 latency; choose hosted + quantization for cost-optimized async/batch use cases.”
Kai (Sales): Please include a 3-line AE talk track and a 4-question discovery checklist (residency, p95/p99 targets, expected qps, compliance needs).
Becca (Content): AE talk track (3 lines): “We provide a consistent API across hosted, reserved, and private so you can start serverless and upgrade without code changes.
We protect keys and audit trails, and offer SLA-backed capacity for mission-critical routes.
Routing policies and automated fallbacks keep apps online during bursts.”
